# PyTorch Precision Converter

> `precision-convert` (`pip install pytorch-precision-converter`) converts PyTorch checkpoints, safetensors files and Hugging Face model folders between fp32, fp16, bf16, fp8 and ComfyUI `fp8_scaled`, `int8_convrot` and `int8`; dequantizes scaled FP8 and int8 models (DeepSeek and Qwen block-scaled FP8, compressed-tensors, ComfyUI fp8 and int8) back to BF16 on a CPU; merges or splits sharded safetensors; and extracts EMA weights. It streams tensors one at a time, so models larger than RAM work. CPU only, Python 3.9+, PyTorch 2.1+.

Each task is one command:

- Convert to fp16 or bf16: `precision-convert model.safetensors -p bf16`
- ComfyUI fp8_scaled (per-layer `comfy_quant` format, ComfyUI v0.4.0+): `precision-convert model.safetensors -p fp8_scaled -o model-fp8_scaled.safetensors`
- fp8_scaled of a fine-tune with the same layers as an official Comfy-Org release, renaming Hugging Face names to ComfyUI's: `precision-convert finetune/model.safetensors.index.json -p fp8_scaled --like https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/.../official_fp8_scaled.safetensors -o finetune_fp8_scaled.safetensors`
- ComfyUI int8_convrot (rotated int8, per-row scales; ComfyUI v0.27.0+) with the same layers as an official Comfy-Org int8 file: `precision-convert finetune.safetensors -p int8_convrot --like https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/.../official_int8_convrot.safetensors`
- ComfyUI int8 without ConvRot (same format, no Hadamard rotation; faster than int8_convrot on a T4, slower on newer GPUs; ComfyUI v0.27.0+): `precision-convert model.safetensors -p int8 --like https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/.../official_int8_convrot.safetensors`
- FP8 model folder to BF16, updating config.json and the shard index: `precision-convert Qwen3-8B-FP8/ -p bf16`
- Any Hugging Face or Diffusers folder: `precision-convert Llama-3.1-8B/ -p fp16`
- Merge shards into one file: `precision-convert model.safetensors.index.json -o model.safetensors`
- Split into shards with an index: `precision-convert model.safetensors -o out/model.safetensors --max-shard-size 5GB`
- .ckpt to .safetensors without changing dtypes: `precision-convert model.ckpt -st`
- EMA weights from a Stable Diffusion training checkpoint: `precision-convert model.ckpt -t ema-only -p fp16 -st`
- Inspect a file (dtypes, sizes, FP8 layout, EMA, metadata): `precision-convert FILE --info --json`
- Per-layer precision loss: add `--report`. Automatic mixed precision: `--max-error 0.05 --fallback bf16`.

Behaviour for automation: never prompts; `--json` prints one JSON object (`{"ok": false, "error": ...}` on failure); exit codes 0 success, 1 conversion failed, 2 invalid arguments; refuses to overwrite without `--overwrite`; loads `.ckpt`/`.pt` with `weights_only=True` unless `--unsafe-load`.
